description:
Job Requirements
 Maintain current website 
 Make HTTPS work for several products 
 Implement a source code tracking mechanism 
 Move the marketing site from GoDaddy to Pair 
 Demonstrable experience building real and scalable online client/server applications in Java and/or  Linux/Apache/PHP (or LAMP) environment and being able to make a meaningful contribution from day one is a must. Experience with PHP frameworks such as Codeigniter, Symfony, Zend, Cake, Fuel (preferred) is essential. Candidate must be fully versed in Object Oriented Programming within PHP and have experience with Model-View-Controller concepts and RESTful interfaces. 
 Must be well versed in JavaScript and must possess and be willing to demonstrate the ability to effectively prototype objects and methods, use objects and work with data (such as JSON). Outside-the-box experience with JavaScript libraries such as ExtJS4 (Preferred), jQuery and JS Prototype is crucial. Possessing cross-browser compatibility understanding is paramount to success. 
 Candidate must have experience in one or more databases and should be familiar with noSQL products and concepts. 
 
 Website developer
 Maintain and fix website
  

 Immediate opening. Part time job. Remotely. Send your rate with resume.
